description.describe_ch: 課程設計針對學生修習完憲法、民法、刑法、行政法、英美法等基礎法律學程後，就醫事法進行深度整合之學習為目標。擬定特定議題，邀請具有法學碩、博士學位之各領域醫療專家、醫事法學者以及專精醫療訴訟實務之法官，以講座方式與學生進行面對面的互動式教學。透過醫師與專家的觀點進行醫事法律的整合教學，消弭隔行如隔山的學科限制，學生可更貼近各項醫事法議題背後真實的醫療實務面，並與己身所學之法律概念相印証。期盼能培養學生對於醫事法議題獨立之思考與判斷能力，進一步建立起學生未來從事醫事法之學術研究或訴訟實務之紮實基礎。
description.describe_eh: The design of this course aims to provide in-depth interdisciplinary integration learning in medical law for students who have completed basic legal courses such as Constitutional Law, Civil Law, Criminal Law, Administrative Law, and Anglo-American Law. For specific topics, experts with master's or doctoral degrees in law, as well as medical professionals, medical law scholars, and judges specializing in medical litigation practices, are invited to engage in face-to-face interactive teaching through lectures. By incorporating the perspectives of doctors and experts, the course aims to integrate medical law education, breaking down the barriers between different fields of study. This allows students to gain closer insights into the real-world medical practices behind various medical law issues and relate them to the legal concepts they have learned. The goal is to cultivate students' ability to independently think and make judgments on medical law issues, establishing a solid foundation for future academic research or litigation practice in the field of medical law.
